subject: Import the eval runtime checks from the package
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-09: imint/eval/nfi_amendment.py (sealed_runtime) and imint/eval/fieldtruth.py (verify_evaluation_source) import scripts.crop_distill_provenance inside functions, so they fail with ModuleNotFoundError: scripts in an installed wheel. Move the code verify_runtime, snapshot_tree and tree_payload_sha256 reach (ProvenanceError, the image and archive pins, the tree-identity helpers) into the imint package as byte-identical spans, have scripts/crop_distill_provenance.py import it from imint so there is one implementation, and extend tests/smoke_installed_package.py and the installed-library CI job to exercise both eval modules without torch. Follow-up to task 0160 (PR #155). Not in scope: job manifests, the sealed ladder-crop-distill images, and the IM-023 freeze and amendment manifests, which keep their own code pins. Review: fresh Claude reviewer; integration is Tobias's decision.
